rationale: The continuation premise has decayed before invalidation was hit — zero favorable excursion in 10 minutes, push volume collapsed from ~4500 to a few hundred prints per minute, and EWG's relative strength has faded to essentially in-line with SPY (-0.26% vs -0.28% on the day) while overhead supply at $42.84–$42.87 still caps the gap-fill target. Exiting near break-even (-$3.50) is cheaper than tying risk to a stalled breakout under a weak tape (VIXY +1.21%). A flip to short is not warranted: shorting above VWAP and a rising 9-EMA at 96% of the day's range is poor location, and the short only becomes mechanically valid on a confirmed loss of the $42.73 micro-base.
